models_evaluated: AI bone X-ray software detecting fractures, dislocations, and elbow effusion (name not given)

links.outcome: Local retrospective ED bone X-ray performance of AI vs senior radiologist reference standard
links.effect: Fracture detection: AI Sens 95.8%, Spec 97.6% (residents 90.6%, 98%). Dislocation detection: residents higher (Sens 77.8%, Spec 100%) than AI, so local performance was strong for fractures but weaker for dislocations.
links.quote: The RR achieved higher Sens (77.8%) and Spec (100%) for dislocation detection compared to AI.

screen.reason: Retrospective diagnostic accuracy study evaluating an AI software on emergency department bone radiographs compared to radiology residents and a gold standard senior radiologist.
